about: Part 05 section D: Pious Defender Boots (Cleric row 27400), one Snake Charm, two Lost Treasure bracers, Prelude to War Frozen helms, no XP for Druid Medicine / Evening the Odds (D5 skipped)

entries.why: the Cleric reward of Information / Trickery did not exist, so Clerics got no boots; built from the period item data (studded, AF 26, ABS 19, Con 3, Piety 3, Power 2, level 13 like its Defender Boots siblings, studded boots model 84)
entries.source: Allakhazam item 17017 'Pious Defender Boots' (Albion, Feet, Armor: Studded, Requires Class: Cleric, AF 26, Absorb 19, Constitution 3, Piety 3, Power Pool 2% - the 1.87 conversion of +2 Power; level to attain 12, quest Information / Trickery); Allakhazam quest 588 comment 'Pious Defender Boots. They were Piety 3, Con 3, Pow 2' and reward list 'Pious Defender Boots -- Cleric'

row.Description: Three Drakoran border watchers each carry a scroll with [information] I want. And one of the ladies here needs the essence of a corpse candle.

entries.why: Cleric variant of Information / Trickery split out of row 20569 (classes 4|6|14|16|17|18|15|20, no reward) so Clerics get their period Pious Defender Boots (Allakhazam 588 reward list)

the reward cq_snake_charm|cq_alb_snake_charm handed out two identical 'Snake Charm' jewels; the period reward is one Snake Charm (Allakhazam quest 6; period item 624 Con 3, level 5, which the rules give cq_snake_charm)

set.StepText: Get an archiator hide from a Drakoran archiator just over the bridge southwest of Fort Gwyntell.|Get blue slime from a blue-green algae on the coast west of Caer Diogel.|Get apple tree sap from the lamia Larionne at the northern end of Clifton (talk to her; you do not have to kill her).|Use the slime.|Use the tree sap.|Use the knife with the archiator hide; an apple tree spirit appears. Talk to it.|Free the soul of the young sorceress Eralyne, a zombie at the graveyard near Caer Sidi.|Bring the statue to Ariette in the woods behind Fort Gwyntell and choose two different bracers.|Choose your first bracer: whisper Ariette the name of the item you want (Bracer of Health, Bracer of the Strong, Bracer of the Magical, Bracer of Shielding, Bracer of the Stealthy, Pious Bracer, Roguish Bracer, Charismatic Bracer).|Choose your second bracer, a different one: whisper Ariette its name (Bracer of Health, Bracer of the Strong, Bracer of the Magical, Bracer of Shielding, Bracer of the Stealthy, Pious Bracer, Roguish Bracer, Charismatic Bracer).
set.SourceText: Get an archiator hide from a Drakoran archiator just over the bridge southwest of Fort Gwyntell.||||||||Choose your reward: [Bracer of Health], [Bracer of the Strong], [Bracer of the Magical], [Bracer of Shielding], [Bracer of the Stealthy], [Pious Bracer], [Roguish Bracer], [Charismatic Bracer].|Choose your reward: [Bracer of Health], [Bracer of the Strong], [Bracer of the Magical], [Bracer of Shielding], [Bracer of the Stealthy], [Pious Bracer], [Roguish Bracer], [Charismatic Bracer].

entries.why: Ariette gave one bracer; the period reward is two different bracers ('She offers you 2 bracers as reward. You can't choose the same Bracer 2 times', Allakhazam 729): step 9 becomes a first choose step (type 8) and a new step 10 the second (type 9, final XP/coin moved there).
the second bracer choice (same eight bracers, same Ariette marker) as the new step 10
the quest's experience moves with the final reward to the new last step 10

entries.why: Prelude to War gave no item; the period reward is a class-dependent Frozen helm from Saffron (Allakhazam 296: 'Upon killing Saffron, you will get a one time drop that is dependant on class ... friars will get the Frozen Leather Helm while Clerics get the Frozen Stone Helm'). It is the final reward, made per class through ClassRewards (step kill items do not go through ClassRewards)

Prelude to War's helm per class: Cleric Frozen Stone Helm and Friar Frozen Leather Helm (Allakhazam 296); by armour type for the rest (CHOICE, the period names only those two): Armsman/Paladin the plate helm (its page lists Armsman, Paladin), Infiltrator leather, the casters (Theurgist, Wizard, Sorcerer, Necromancer, Cabalist) the quilted cap (Intelligence/Power), Scout/Minstrel/Mercenary/Reaver the studded Frozen Boned Helm (the base reward)
